import hashlib, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
w = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='tameshi-r1-interactive-'))
try:
    target = w / 'target.sh'
    target.write_bytes(b'#!/usr/bin/env bash\nvalue=good\nunused=quiet\nprintf \'%s\\n\' "$value"\n')
    spec = w / 'defects.spec'
    spec.write_text('@defect wrong-value | asserted output changes\n@old value=good\n@new value=bad\n@defect unread-value | unasserted assignment changes\n@old unused=quiet\n@new unused=loud\n')
    before = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    command = ['bash', 'tools/mutate-and-run.sh', '--target', str(target), '--defects', str(spec), '--suite', 'test "$(bash "$MUTANT")" = good', '--workdir', str(w / 'run'), '--label', 'fleet-round-1-interactive-canonical-smoke', '--timeout', '15', '--tail', '1']
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    print(result.stdout, end='')
    print(result.stderr, end='')
    print('SMOKE_RUNNER_EXIT: ' + str(result.returncode))
    after = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert 'CONTROL: GREEN (exit=0 ' in result.stdout
    assert 'DEFECT wrong-value: KILLED (exit=1 ' in result.stdout
    assert 'DEFECT unread-value: SURVIVED (exit=0 ' in result.stdout
    assert 'MUTATE_RESTORE: OK ' in result.stdout
    assert 'defects=2 killed=1 survived=1 inconclusive=0 kill-rate=50%' in result.stdout
    assert before == after
    assert str(w).startswith('/tmp/tameshi-r1-')
    print('SMOKE_ASSERTIONS: PASS (control, kill, survivor, restore, canonical-scratch; independent-sha256=' + after + ')')
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(w)
